“This is what Hell looks like. These are the tents Israel bombed on the grounds of a school shelter in Bureij — while Netanyahu was arriving at the White House.” -@mosab_abutoha 
Footage by @momen__sameer 

The New York Times systematically hides Israel’s war crimes. Today instead of reporting on this barbaric Israeli massacre of Palestinian civilians, The NYT chose to post 2 articles attempting to legitimize war criminal Netanyahu’s trip to The White House.
Note: The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu for on November 21, 2024. There was no mention of Netanyahu’s ICC Arrest Warrant in the Times’ several articles about his trip to Washington DC. 

Stop paying for lies. Unsubscribe from the New York Times now. ❌  Follow Palestinian journalist @momen__sameer for the truth on the ground in G za.
